text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

I got a lottery ticket from the shopping street. It's always nice to win even a small prize.
I think I'll let Admire Groove draw it.
So, while showing off the raffle tickets stuffed into the bulging bag alongside the purchases—
choice_data_list: Alv, go test your luck and draw one

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Why me?
choice_data_list: No, no, both my hands are full...
No, no, both my hands are full...

text_block_list.text: Using the excuse that my hands were completely full with luggage, I urged her to go on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—...Understood.
Please don't complain even if you don't win, okay?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Yes, welcome! One ticket for the lottery, right?
I'm sure you'll win something good, young lady.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Things don't go that smoothly in the real world.
Statistically speaking, there are far more misses than hits anyway.)

Admire Groove slowly turns
the lever of the raffle drum.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring trip... apparently.
To think we actually won...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Why is it suddenly decided that I'm the one going?
choice_data_list: Because Alv was the one who won it...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...These lottery tickets were yours to begin with, Trainer.
choice_data_list: It's for two, so you know, maybe with Air Groove or someone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That's not the issue—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Well, let's put this discussion on hold for now.
Fortunately, the expiration date is more than a year away.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Besides, I really don't have time for that right now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: To defeat the powerhouses of the Senior Class, I must be stricter with myself than ever before.
While I want them to cherish the bond that's finally formed, forcing it on them any further would be impossible.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back quickly.
After all, we have plenty to do.

And so,
what to do with the travel tickets was shelved for another day.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"'The supreme dish generously made with the shopping district's prized specialty ingredients'...
I think before—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: All the ingredients used at the academy are high quality and packed with nutrients. Perfect for building up the body.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However... in this shopping district, "special ingredients"
that disregard cost and surpass even the academy's food
in nutritional value occasionally circulate.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Could such a thing really...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Above all, the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak" made entirely
from those ingredients boasts tremendous restorative effects
against fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I ate that before as well and threw myself into even more training. You should give it a try if you get the chance.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...Once, that person did the same, using it as the source of strength to elevate himself to that realm...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (The ideals she pursues are high. That goes... for me as well. In that case—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Beyond the 'Special Carrot Hamburg Steak,'
lies Air Groove-san's... and my own path.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll be taking this with me.
Is that all right?"

She had an overbearing air that brooked no argument, but her sincerity came through.
In her own way, she might have been paying respect to someone.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".
choice_data_list: Talk about lucky, it looks super fresh.
Talk about lucky, it looks super fresh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, well.
One look is all it takes to understand.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "With this much, it looks like we can make all kinds of dishes—salads, grilled dishes, stir-fries, and stews."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...Ideally, the best move is to eat it before it loses its freshness...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(There are a few conditioning routines
I'd like to try... If I'm going to test them, it's now.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll use these to make a body-building menu.
A full-course carrot meal.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I will only teach you this once, so please remember it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Carrots are an all-purpose ingredient that prevents rough skin, boosts immunity, maintains mucous membranes, and regulates intestinal function.
This will directly lead to improved performance.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"There will be benefits for you as well, Trainer.
Even recently—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
“...Lacking sleep again?
You're going to ruin your health, you know.”

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please take care of your own health.
If you collapse, work will grind to a halt.
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she's actually trying to warn me...?)

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she is gradually becoming able to pay attention
to things beyond just herself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Once you can cook a full-course carrot meal,
you should be able to prevent it yourself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll head back and start selecting recipes.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —...Or so they say.
choice_data_list: Like I said earlier, my hands are full, so...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
What am I supposed to do with this?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: *sigh* No ideas, huh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
In the trainer's office fridge...
there were some apples and lemons left over, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let's buy some more bananas on the way home.
I'll make juice out of them to drink before morning practice.

"Admire Groove wasted nothing that could serve
as nourishment for her to grow stronger."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
Well, about what I expected.
choice_data_list: W-Well, you might as well take it...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: After you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I have quite enough, thank you.

"I hurriedly chased after her
as she walked briskly away from the scene."
